scenes.time: First day in gold light; at dusk the light fails and it is night (c03.s01.p007.1, p008.1)
scenes.key_moment: Okonta lying back in the water at night beside the moored needle, its faint light pulsing like something asleep, while pale whale song falls from far above (c03.s01.p007.2, p007.4, p008.2, p008.3)

backgrounds: Kelp forest by day, gold blur, open water
Kelp forest at night, needle moored to a kelp stem

scenes.time: Second to third day; light fails a few metres into the kelp; evening when herded to the Slick (c03.s02.p007.3, p015.3)
scenes.key_moment: The kelp stops at a line as sharp as a shoreline; black dead bitterwrack and strong-tea water beyond, with shreds hanging in it (c03.s02.p019.2, p019.6, p019.7, p019.8, p019.9, p019.10)

backgrounds: The Tangle: thick groaning kelp, wrecks furred with weed
Sounding: broken dome, pale ribs, silt floor, stair to nothing, ring of bare sand
The Slick: dead black bitterwrack wall, tea-brown water
expressions: Okonta: mouth set in a line (p015.3)

scenes.time: Days four to six of the wait; sixth day at the turn of the morning watch, per the almanac (c03.s03.p003.9, p013.2)
scenes.key_moment: The Dragon stops above the stone, its blunt eyeless head turned to Wrack, a panel sliding open like an eyelid, as Wrack lays his palm on it (c03.s03.p029.3, p029.4, p029.5, p029.6, p029.7, p032.1)

backgrounds: Greywatch Stone: bare rise, hexagonal pale pillar, ring of benches scratched with names, small camp in a lee hollow
Open water above the stone with the Dragon passing
sprites: Brask (huge, red beard, sealskin coat fur inside)
The diver officer (helmet with stripe, faceplate lamp)
expressions: Diver officer: gone white, gun lowered (p019.1, p019.2)

scenes.time: Three days north; first evening, first night, second day, third day (c03.s04.p005.3, p010.1, p012.1, p017.1)
scenes.key_moment: Six white singers running alongside the Dragon, rolling to look in through the bound water, a calf near enough that the scars on its mother's flank show (c03.s04.p010.3, p010.4, p010.5, p010.7)

backgrounds: The gallery: flooded hall, ribs arching to a point of light, walls of bright bound water, hammock-nets, cradles, names along the floor
Pale whales alongside, seen through the wall
Deep cold blue water below the forest
